notes: Four portable public-API cases exercise one standard MIM subclass beneath each interaction category named by §11.3.1 p. 290 l. 18-5: federate adjust, federate request, federate service, and federation adjust. This is representative branch evidence, not an exhaustive test of arbitrary FOM-added subclasses or complete MOM semantics.

requirements.source_symbol: MOM interaction reception beneath federate/federation adjust, request, and service classes
requirements.statement: The RTI shall receive interaction classes that are subclasses of HLAmanager.HLAfederate.HLAadjust, HLAmanager.HLAfederate.HLArequest, HLAmanager.HLAfederate.HLAservice, and HLAmanager.HLAfederation.HLAadjust.
